notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (www.wonderchef.com/robots.txt) has generic User-agent:* rules only (disallows /cart /checkout /orders /account /search and a handful of named backend collections e.g. appliance-collection, chef-recommendation, 10k, categories - none of the nodes recorded here are on that list); no Claude/anthropic-ai specific disallow. Proceeded entirely via tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124) - site is a standard server-rendered Shopify storefront, no client-rendered nav gap requiring Playwright/Chrome. TREE METHOD: union of (1) rendered homepage + header-sidebar section nav (all top-level links are appliance/cookware categories - air-fryer, appliances, chimneys, cookware, mixer-grinder, otgs, etc - no Textile/Storage parent in the mega-menu), (2) sitemap_collections_1.xml (867 collection URLs total), and (3) each candidate collection page's own h1/canonical (verified every recorded node's canonical URL and h1 text matched the requested slug). Because this is fundamentally a kitchen-appliance/cookware brand, no menu section groups any Textile or Storage nodes together - all qualifying nodes below are flat, sitemap-only leaf collections not linked from the visible mega-menu, so no synthetic grouping rows were invented (none exist in the site's own structure). QTY METHOD: each collection's own /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 endpoint (Shopify native JSON, single page since every count here is well under the 250 cap) - array length used as the exact qty; cross-checked against the rendered page's own product-card links and, for two collections, the page's own 'No products found' empty-state text. EXCLUDED (Kitchen & Dining / boundary, not Textile or Storage): kitchen-tools (85 products, general kitchen gadgets hub), kitchen-accessories (62 products, general choppers/knives/spatulas/serveware hub - dominated by non-storage kitchen tools even though it also lists the 2 'Containers' products), pickle-jar-set-serveware (0 products, product_type Serveware - jars for serving, not storage), back-to-office-lunch-boxes-food-bot-nb-personal (2 products, identical set to glass-lunch-boxes - a promotional/seasonal campaign collection, excluded per View-All/Collections rule, genuine listing page glass-lunch-boxes recorded instead), tiffin-bags (0 products - h1/canonical confirmed genuine empty category, but a tiffin bag is a personal food-carrying bag, not a home storage/organization product nor a home textile, excluded per storage.md 6 fashion/lifestyle-carrying-bag boundary), bread-baskets-roti-covers (0 products - h1/canonical confirmed genuine empty category; combines 'bread baskets' which is Kitchen & Dining serveware with 'roti covers' which could be textile or storage depending on the actual product, but with zero live products there is no way to verify primary product type, so excluded from both arrays rather than forced per storage.md 42 / textile.md ambiguity handling), nutriblend/mixer-grinder jar collections (appliance accessory jars, not storage containers), storage-shelving-style generic hubs (none exist on this site). No company-wide block encountered.
